findings.message: Match the workspace folder to the actual repository mount. When the checkout directory is not named exactly `ProxmoxMCP-Plus`, Dev Containers mounts it under a different `/workspaces/<directory-name>` path. Setting `workspaceFolder` does not change that mount, so VS Code opens a nonexistent directory and the post-create command cannot install the project. Use the actual mounted directory or configure an explicit matching `workspaceMount`, and update the interpreter path accordingly.

Install development dependencies from a supported definition. On a fresh container, this command installs only runtime dependencies: `pyproject.toml` uses Hatchling and declares no `dev` extra, so the development extras in `setup.py` are ignored. Consequently, pytest and pytest-asyncio are missing and the repository's tests cannot run. Install `requirements-dev.in` as part of setup or declare the extra in `pyproject.toml`.
